senses.gloss:
तुर् 1. तुर् (connected with rts. तॄ, त्वर्,
and तूर्), cl. 6. P. A., Ved. तुरति, -ते, &c.,
to hurry, hasten, press forwards, run; overcome; in-
jure; cl. 3. P., Ved. तुतोर्ति: Caus. तुरयति, -यितुम्,
to run: Desid., Ved. तूतूर्षति: Intens. A., Ved.
in the part. तर्तुराण, running forwards; [cf. rt.
त्वर्; Gr. τύρ-βη, τύρ-βα, τυρβάζω, τυρβασία,
Τυρ-μ-ίδαι; Lat. turba, turbare, turb-idu-s, turma;
Angl. Sax. thrym, ‘multitude, mass, troop;’ Goth.
thaurp; Old Germ. dorf, ‘conference, assembly,
meeting;’ Old Island. thyrpaz, ‘to congregate.’]

2. तुर्, तूर्, तूर्, तूर्, Ved. running a race, hasten-
ing, fighting, conquering, a warrior; [cf. अप्-तुर्,
आजि-तुर्, &c.]

तूर् 2. तूर्, र्, र्, र् (fr. त्वर्), hastening; a
courier; (र्), f. speed, swift motion, swiftness; [cf.
2. तुर्.]

1. तुर, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. 3. तुर see p. 379, col. 1),
Ved. furthering, promoting, a promoter; quick, will-
ing, prompt; (अम्), ind. quickly.
—तुर-ग, अस्, m.
‘going quickly,’ a horse; the mind, thought; (ई), f.
a mare, = अश्व-गन्धा, the plant Physalis Flexuosa;
[cf. तुरङ्-ग and तुरङ्-गम.]
—तुरग-गन्धा,
f. = तुर-गी, Physalis Flexuosa; [cf. तुरङ्ग-गन्धा.]
—तुरग-दानव or तुरग-दैत्य, अस्, m. ‘horse-
[]
titan’ or ‘Dānava in the shape of a horse,’ an epithet
of Keśin.
—तुरग-नील-ताल, अस्, m. a kind of
gesture with the hand.
—तुरग-प्रिय, अस् or अम्,
m. or n. (?), barley, ‘liked by horses;’ [cf. तुरङ्ग-
प्रिय.]
—तुरग-ब्रह्म-चर्यक, अम्, n. the
sexual restraint of horses, i. e. compulsory celibacy,
leading a life of continence, in consequence merely
of being without female society.
—तुरग-मेध,
अस्, m. a horse-sacrifice, = अश्व-मेध.
—तुरग-
रक्ष, अस्, m. ‘horse-guardian,’ a groom, an equery.
—तुरग-लीलक, अस्, m. a particular time in music.
—तुरग-वदन or तुरगानन (˚ग-आन्˚), आस्,
m. pl. ‘horse-faced,’ N. of a race in the north of
Madhya-deśa.
—तुर-गातु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. going
quickly.
—तुरगारोह (˚ग-आर्˚), अस्, m. ‘one
mounted on a horse,’ a horseman.
—तुरगिन्, ई,
इणी, इ, equestrian, riding, mounted or carried on a
horse; (ई), m. a horseman, a cavalier.
—तुरगीय,
an adj. derived fr. तुर-ग in खर-तुरगीय-सम्-
पर्क, अस्, m. sexual intercourse between asses
and horses.
—तुरगोपचारक (˚ग-उप्˚), अस्, m.
‘attending to horses,’ a groom, an equery.
—तुरङ्-
ग, अस्, m. ‘going quickly,’ a horse; a N. of the
number seven (because of the seven horses of the
sun); the mind considered as the seat of feeling as
well as of intellect, the heart; (ई), f. a mare, =
तुर-गी, Physalis Flexuosa, = घोटिका, Cucumis Uti-
lissimus; [cf. तुर-ग and तुरङ्-गम.]
—तुरङ्-
गक, अस्, m. the plant Luffa Fœtida; (इका), f. a
kind of cucurbitaceous plant, = देव-दाली, the large
dark-green pumpkin.
—तुरङ्ग-गन्धा, f. = तु-
रग-गन्धा.
—तुरङ्ग-द्विषणी, f. (for -द्वे-
षणि), a she-buffalo.
—तुरङ्ग-नाथ, अस्, m.,
N. of the chief of a sect.
—तुरङ्ग-प्रिय, अस्, m.
= तुरग-प्रिय, barley.
—तुरङ्-गम, अस्, m. a
horse; (ई), f. a mare; [cf. तुर-ग and तुरङ्-ग.]
—तुरङ्गम-शाला, f. a horse-stable.
—तुरङ्ग-
मेध, अस्, m. a horse-sacrifice, = अश्व-मेध.
—तुरङ्ग-यायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going on horseback.
—तुरङ्ग-वक्त्र or तुरङ्ग-वदन, अस्, m.
‘horse-faced,’ a Kinnara or chorister of Indra's heaven.
—तुरङ्ग-सादिन्, ई, m. a horseman, a horse-soldier.
—तुरङ्ग-स्कन्ध, अस्, m. a troop of horses.
—तुरङ्ग-स्थान, अम्, n. a horse-stable.
—तु-
रङ्गारि (˚ग-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of the horse,’ a
buffalo; fragrant oleander (करवीर).
—तुरङ्गा-
रूढ (˚ग-आर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, mounted on horseback;
(अस्), m. a horseman.
—तुरङ्गिन्, ई, m. a horse-
man, a rider, a groom; [cf. तुरगिन्.]
—तुर-या,
आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. going quickly.

तुर 2. तुर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. तु; for 1. तुर
see p. 378, col. 3), Ved. strong, powerful, excelling,
surpassing, overpowering; an epithet of Indra, of the
Maruts, Ādityas, &c.; possessed of property; rich;
abundant, abounding; (अस्), m., N. of a preceptor
and priest with the patronymic Kāvaṣeya.
—तुरा-
षाह्, -षाट्, ट्, ट्, overpowering the mighty or over-
powering quickly, epithet of Indra and of Viṣṇu;
(ट्), m. a N. of Indra.

तुर 3. तुर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. hurt, wounded;
(according to Sāy. = आ-तुर, q. v.)

तूर तूर, अम्, n. = 1. तूर्य, any musical in-
strument; (ई), f. a thorn-apple; [cf. अर्ध-तूर.]

तुरण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. quick, swift, energetic;
(अम्), n. haste.

तुरण्य, nom. P., Ved. तुरण्यति, &c., to be
quick or swift; to make haste, to accelerate.

तुरण्य-सद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. dwelling among the
quick or active.

तुरण्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. quick, swift, energetic,
zealous.
तुरस्-पेय, अम्, n., Ved. anything drunk quickly (?).

1. तुरी, f., Ved. overpowering strength, superior
power. (For 2. तुरी see col. 2.)

तुरी 2. तुरी, f. (or तुरि, इस्, in the first
sense; cf. तुलि), the fibrous stick used by weavers to
clean and separate the threads of the woof; a painter's
brush; a shuttle; N. of a wife of Kṛṣṇa (or Vasu-
deva) and mother of Jaras. (For 1. तुरी see col. 1.)
तुर्या, f., Ved. overpowering or superior strength.
तुर्या तुर्या, f. See col. 1.

तुर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = 2. तुरीय, fourth, a fourth;
(अम्), n. the fourth state of the soul, in which it be-
comes one with Brahma, a quarter; (अस्, आ, अम्), being
in the above state; the fourth (part).
—तुर्य-वह् or
-वाह्, ट्, f. तुर्यौही, Ved. an ox or cow four years old.
तुर्य तुर्य. See above under 2. तुरीय.

तूर्य 1. तूर्य, अम्, n., Ved. an abstract noun
of 2. तुर्, occurring at the end of comp. [cf. अप्-
तूर्य under अप्त, &c.]; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a musical
instrument, of which four kinds are sometimes
reckoned, (wind instruments, stringed instruments,
&c.); स-तूर्य, accompanied by music; स-तूर्यम्,
with music; [cf. मङ्गल-त्˚, मृत्यु-त्˚, याम-त्˚,
तौर्य.]
—तूर्य-खण्ड, अस्, m. a musical instru-
ment, a sort of tabor.
—तूर्य-मय, अस्, ई, अम्,
representing music, musical.
—तूर्यौघ (˚य-
ओघ), अस्, m. a band of instruments.

तूर्य 2. तूर्य, अस्, आ, अम् (for तुर्य), a fourth,
a quarter.

तुरायण, अस्, m. (a patronymic fr. 2. तुर), N.
of a man; (अम्), n., N. of a particular sacrifice or
vow, = पौर्णमास-विकार, a modification of the
full moon sacrifice; N. of a Sattra; (अस्, आ, अम्), m.
f. n. attachment to any object or pursuit; attached
to any object or pursuit (?); [cf. परायण.]

तुरकिन् तुरकिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Turkish; [cf.
तुरुष्क.]

तुरक्व तुरक्व, N. of a people, ‘the Turks;’
[cf. तुरुष्क.]
तुरग तुर-ग, तुरङ्ग. See 1. तुर, p. 378.

तुरष्क तुरष्क, N. of a country and people
mentioned in the Śrī-ṣavāyaṇa or part of the Ro-
maka-siddhānta.
तुराषाह् तुरा-षाह्. See 2. तुर, col. 1.

तुरीप तुरीप, अम्, n., Ved. seminal fluid;
(अस्), m. an epithet of Tvaṣṭṛ, ‘spermatic.’

तुरीय 1. तुरीय, P., Ved. तुरीयति, &c., to
go or move; [cf. rt. 1. तुर् and तुरण्य.]

तुरीय 2. तुरीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fourth, a
fourth; consisting of four parts; whose power ex-
tends on all four sides, mighty; (अम्), n. the fourth
state of the soul (according to the Vedānta phil.),
that state in which it has become one with Brahma
or the universal spirit; (अस्, आ, अम्), (with a different
accent), a fourth, constituting the fourth part; (अम्),
n. a fourth part, a quarter; [cf. तुर्य and चतुर्थ.]
—तुरीय-भाग, अस्, m. a fourth part or share.
—तुरीय-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, a sharer of a fourth
—तुरीय-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the
fourth caste; (अस्), m. the fourth caste or tribe, a
Śūdra.
—तुरीयांश (˚य-अं˚), अस्, m. a fourth
part or share, a quarter.
—तुरीयातीत (˚य-अत्˚), N.
of an Upaniṣad.
—तुरीयार्ध (˚य-अर्˚), अम्, n.
one half of a fourth, an eighth part.
तुरीयक, अस्, आ, अम्, a fourth (part).

तुरुष्क तुरुष्क, आस्, m. pl., N. of a race,
the Indo-Scythian race or Turks; (अस्), m. the country
of this race, Turan or Turkestan; a prince of this
race; (अस्, अम्), m. n. olibanum, Indian incense,
the resin of the Boswellia Serrata; the resin of the
Pinus Longifolia; [cf. यावन.]

तुर्फरि तुर्फरि, Ved. (fr. rt. तृफ्), accord-
ing to Yāska = क्षिप्र-हन्तृ, striking quickly; (ac-
cording to Sāy., तुर्फरी, du. = killers of the enemy.)

तुर्फरीतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. according to Yāska
= हन्तृ, striking; (according to Sāy., तुर्फरीतू,
du. = तर्फितारौ = शत्रूणां हन्तारौ.)

तुर्व् तुर्व् [cf. rt. 1. तुर्], cl. 1. P., Ved. तूर्-
वति, तुतूर्व, तूर्वितुम्, to overpower,
overcome, excel; to cause to overpower or conquer,
help to victory; to save; to strike, to hurt, kill,
injure; [cf. तूर्वयाण and तूर्वि.]

तुर्वणि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. 1. तुर्), Ved. overpowering,
excelling, victorious; (Sāy.) acting quickly, serving
quickly, moving quickly; injuring or destroying
enemies.

तुर्वन्, अ, n., Ved. (only used in the dat. तुर्-
वणे), conquering, defeating, injuring.

तुर्वश तुर्वश, अस्, m. (also written तुर्वसु),
Ved., N. of a hero and ancestor of the Āryan race,
often mentioned in the Ṛg-veda and probably re-
lated to the Kaṇvas; he is generally mentioned
together with his brother Yadu; N. of a whole
race; [cf. तुर्वसु and तौर्वश.]

तुर्वसु तुर्वसु, उस्, m. (a later form of
तुर्वश), N. of a son of Yayāti and Devayāni and
brother of Yadu.

तुर्वीति तुर्वीति, इस्, m., Ved., N. of a man
or of a race.

तूर्घ्न तूर्घ्न, अम्, n., N. of the northern
part of Kuru-kṣetra.

तूर्ण तूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. तुर्व् and त्वर्),
quick, expeditious; fleet; (अम्), n. rapidity, quickness;
(अम्), ind. quick, swift, quickly, speedily, in haste;
[cf. Hib. tonn, ‘quick.’]
—तूर्ण-वनि, quickly
honouring or serving, (a word made by Yāska to
explain the etymology of तुर्वणि, q. v.)
—तूर्णो-
दित (˚ण-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, spoken quickly, uttered
rapidly.
तूर्ण = त्वरित. See p. 381, col. 2.

तूर्णक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a sort of rice
which ripens quickly.

तूर्णि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. quick, swift, expeditious;
clever, zealous; (इस्), m. f. speed, velocity, expedi-
tion; (इस्), m. the mind; a Śloka; dirt, excrement.
—तूर्ण्य्-अर्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. pursuing an object
with zeal, eager to accomplish a purpose; (Sāy.)
going quickly.
तूर्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. quick, speedy.

तूर्णाश तूर्णाश, अम्, n., Ved. water; a
waterfall (?).

तूर्वयाण तूर्वयाण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. तुर्व्),
Ved. overpowering; (Sāy.) going quickly, having a
rapid course (as if तूर्व-यान); (अस्), m., N. of a
man.

तूर्वि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. excelling, superior; (Sāy.)
quick, rapid.
